answer: A comet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ember of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The zephyr of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on invitation quota tree, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, rewards vest against future work.
